results: 1. slit-lamp examination for Kayser-Fleischer rings: no rings
2. copper / caeruloplasmin / 24 h urinary copper: NORMAL - excludes Wilson disease
3. dystonia gene panel: biallelic GLB1 variants
4. lysosomal enzyme assay (beta-galactosidase, hexosaminidase): REDUCED beta-galactosidase, with 5-10% residual activity - type-III GM1 gangliosidosis
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Type III (juvenile/adult-onset, chronic) GM1 gangliosidosis caused by biallelic pathogenic GLB1 variants resulting in lysosomal β-galactosidase deficiency.

Alternative: Hereditary isolated dystonia due to another dystonia-associated gene

Alternative: Neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation (NBIA)

Alternative: Wilson disease (effectively excluded by normal copper studies and absent Kayser–Fleischer rings)
dx: Type III (juvenile/adult-onset, chronic) GM1 gangliosidosis caused by biallelic pathogenic GLB1 variants resulting in lysosomal β-galactosidase deficiency.
